title: What's Hidden Matters: Identifying Planning-Critical Occluded Agents using Vision-Language Models
summary: Autonomous vehicles must safely navigate complex environments where planning-critical agents may be hidden from view. Current approaches often treat all occlusions with uniform conservatism, yielding needlessly defensive driving, or they infer hidden spaces without estimating the impact on the planner. This work bridges the critical gap between perception and planning by enabling Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to identify and reason about the specific hidden agents that are most critical to the ego-vehicle's trajectory. We introduce a novel framework that uses Planning KL-divergence (PKL), an information-theoretic metric, to systematically identify and rank occluded agents based on their impact on the ego vehicle's plan. Using this planning-aware ranking, we employ an expert VLM (GPT-5) to generate rich, structured annotations that capture the visual evidence and reasoning required for this task. We apply this framework to the nuScenes dataset to create a new benchmark focused on high-impact scenarios. We conduct comprehensive experiments on a wide range of general-purpose and domain-adapted VLMs, demonstrating that fine-tuning on our PKL-guided data yields dramatic performance improvements across all models. Notably, our results show that smaller, fine-tuned models significantly outperform their much larger zero-shot counterparts, and that our PKL-guided data selection strategy improves performance by approximately 30\% over random sampling. Our work presents the first systematic approach for training VLMs to focus on planning-critical occlusions, enabling more semantically grounded and efficient risk assessment in autonomous driving.
tldr: The paper introduces a framework that uses Vision-Language Models and a planning-aware metric (PKL) to identify and reason about occluded agents critical to an autonomous vehicle's trajectory, creating a benchmark and showing that fine-tuning on PKL-guided data significantly improves VLM performance for this task.
tldr_zh: 该论文提出一个框架，利用视觉语言模型和规划感知指标（PKL）来识别和推理对自动驾驶车辆轨迹至关重要的遮挡智能体，创建了一个基准，并表明在PKL引导的数据上进行微调能显著提升VLM的性能。
summary_zh: 自主车辆必须在复杂环境中安全行驶，而其中对规划至关重要的智能体可能处于视野盲区。现有方法通常对所有遮挡区域采取统一保守策略，导致过度防御性驾驶，或仅推断隐藏空间却未评估其对规划器的影响。本研究通过使视觉语言模型（VLM）能够识别并推理对自车轨迹最为关键的特定隐藏智能体，弥合了感知与规划之间的关键鸿沟。我们提出一种创新框架，采用信息论度量——规划KL散度（PKL），基于被遮挡智能体对自车规划的影响程度进行系统化识别与排序。利用这种规划感知排序，我们使用专家级VLM（GPT-5）生成富含结构化信息的标注，捕捉完成该任务所需的视觉证据与推理过程。我们将该框架应用于nuScenes数据集，创建了聚焦高影响场景的新基准。通过对广泛通用型及领域自适应型VLM进行全面实验，结果表明基于PKL引导数据进行微调可使所有模型的性能获得显著提升。值得注意的是，实验显示较小规模的微调模型性能大幅优于规模更大的零样本对应模型，且我们提出的PKL引导数据选择策略相较随机采样可提升约30%的性能。本研究首次提出系统性方法以训练VLM聚焦规划关键性遮挡场景，从而在自动驾驶中实现更具语义根基且更高效的风险评估。

title: FurnitureVLA: Learning Long-Horizon Bimanual Furniture Assembly with Vision-Language-Action Model
summary: Current work on robot furniture assembly mostly focuses on toy-scale settings or single-arm manipulation. We introduce FurnitureVLA, the first systematic study of real-scale bimanual furniture assembly using Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs). We formalize the task, develop a scalable simulation pipeline for expert data generation and evaluation, and build a VR teleoperation system for single-operator bimanual control to collect high-quality real-world demonstrations. To address extreme long-horizon assembly with up to 7 subtasks and 1550 control steps, we propose a progress-enhanced VLA, finetuned on semantically grounded subtasks, that jointly predicts actions and a continuous progress signal, enabling automatic subtask transitions and reducing compounding errors during inference. We further study perception and control design factors that critically affect precision in real-scale assembly. FurnitureVLA improves average simulation success from 48% to 80% compared to baselines across three furniture types, with an additional 21% gain from our design factor study. We validate on a real Kinova Gen3 platform with only 16% drop on the hardest task.
tldr: Proposes FurnitureVLA, a progress-enhanced VLA for bimanual furniture assembly, combining simulation-based pretraining with VR-teleoperated real-world data to handle long-horizon assembly tasks across multiple furniture types.
tldr_zh: 提出 FurnitureVLA，一种进度增强的视觉-语言-动作模型，用于双臂家具组装，结合仿真预训练和 VR 遥操作真实世界数据，处理多种家具类型的长时间序列组装任务。
summary_zh: 当前关于机器人家具组装的研究主要集中于玩具级场景或单臂操作。本文提出FurnitureVLA，这是首个利用视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）系统研究真实尺度双臂家具组装的工作。我们对该任务进行了形式化定义，开发了用于专家数据生成与评估的可扩展仿真管线，并构建了单人操作员双臂控制的VR遥操作原型系统，以采集高质量的真实世界演示数据。针对包含最多7个子任务、1550个控制步长的极长时域组装任务，我们提出了一种基于语义子任务微调的进度增强型VLA模型，该模型联合预测动作与持续进度信号，实现了子任务的自动切换并减少了推理过程中的累积误差。我们进一步研究了影响真实尺度组装精度的关键感知与控制设计因素。在三种家具类型的对比实验中，FurnitureVLA将平均仿真成功率从48%提升至80%，而设计因素研究额外带来21%的性能提升。我们在真实Kinova Gen3平台上完成验证，在最困难的任务上成功率仅下降16%。

title: Structured 4D Latent Predictive Model for Robot Planning
summary: Video predictive models are emerging as a powerful paradigm in robotics, offering a promising path toward task generalization, long-horizon planning, and flexible decision-making. However, prevailing approaches often operate on 2D video sequences, inherently lacking the 3D geometric understanding necessary for precise spatial reasoning and physical consistency. We introduce a Structured 4D Latent Predictive Model, which predicts the evolution of a scene's 3D structure in a structured latent space conditioned on observations and textual instructions. Our representation encodes the scene holistically and can be decoded into diverse 3D formats, enabling a more complete and 3D consistent scene understanding. This structured 4D latent predictive model serves as a planner, generating future scenes that are translated into executable actions by a goal-conditioned inverse dynamics module. Experiments demonstrate that our model generates futures with strong visual quality, substantially better 3D consistency and multi-view coherence compared to state-of-the-art video-based planners. Consequently, our full planning pipeline achieves superior performance on complex manipulation tasks, exhibits robust generalization to novel visual conditions, and proves effective on real-world robotic platforms. Our website is available at https://structured-4d-model.github.io/.
tldr: This paper proposes a structured 4D latent predictive model that predicts future 3D scene evolution conditioned on observations and text instructions, enabling a 3D-consistent video prediction planner for robotic manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结构化4D潜空间预测模型，根据观测和文本指令预测未来3D场景演化，为机器人操作提供3D一致的视频预测规划器。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
视频预测模型正成为机器人领域一种强大的范式，为任务泛化、长期规划及灵活决策提供了有前景的路径。然而，现有方法通常基于二维视频序列进行操作，本质上缺乏精确空间推理与物理一致性所需的三维几何理解。我们提出了一种结构化四维潜变量预测模型，该模型在结构化潜空间内基于观测与文本指令预测场景三维结构的演化过程。该表示方式整体性地编码场景，并可解码为多种三维格式，从而实现更完整且三维一致性的场景理解。该结构化四维潜变量预测模型作为规划器，生成未来场景，并通过基于目标条件的逆动力学模块将其转化为可执行动作。实验表明，与最先进的基于视频的规划器相比，我们的模型生成的未来场景具有更强的视觉质量、显著更优的三维一致性及多视角连贯性。因此，我们的完整规划流水线在复杂操作任务中展现出卓越性能，对新颖视觉条件具有稳健的泛化能力，并在真实机器人平台上验证了其有效性。我们的网站访问地址为：https://structured-4d-model.github.io/。

title: Where Am I? Semantic Map Grounding via Vision-Language Models for Multi-Modal Localization
summary: We address robot localization in GPS-denied indoor environments by reframing it as a semantic reasoning task rather than a geometric estimation problem. Motivated by how humans localize using object-level cues and labeled maps, we ask whether a vision-language model, given a front camera image, a polar LiDAR scan, and a top-down semantic grid map, can infer the robot pose. We fine-tune Qwen2.5-VL-7B with LoRA and attach a lightweight regression head that predicts continuous pose coordinates (x, y, theta) directly from the final hidden state, bypassing text generation. Training uses a composite position-and-direction loss with curriculum learning on a custom Gazebo dataset of 120,112 samples and 527 scenes. On the in-distribution test set of 18,017 samples, the model achieves 98.23 percent position accuracy, 98.00 percent direction accuracy, 96.75 percent full pose accuracy, a mean position error of 0.11 m, and a mean orientation error of 5.7 degrees at 0.62 s per sample. Position accuracy drops by only 7.2 percentage points on seven unseen object categories, reaching 90.99 percent, supporting semantic spatial reasoning rather than appearance memorization. With incomplete maps, fine-tuning recovers performance to 93.72 percent position accuracy, showing adaptability to stale or partial map information. Two ablations highlight cross-modal complementarity. Without LiDAR, using only camera and map inputs, position accuracy remains 95.06 percent, only 3.2 percentage points below the full system. However, when the camera sees no visible objects in a wall-facing view, LiDAR sustains 92.33 percent position accuracy, compared with 70.74 percent when neither LiDAR nor visible objects are available. This shows that LiDAR becomes the primary localization signal when camera semantics are unavailable and provides a reliable fallback under occlusion or sparse layouts.
tldr: This paper reframes robot localization in GPS-denied indoor environments as a semantic reasoning task by fine-tuning a vision-language model with LoRA and a regression head to predict continuous pose from camera, LiDAR, and semantic map inputs, achieving high accuracy and robustness to missing modalities.
tldr_zh: 本文将GPS缺失的室内机器人定位重新定义为语义推理任务，通过LoRA和回归头微调视觉语言模型，从摄像头、激光雷达和语义地图输入中预测连续位姿，实现了高精度和对缺失模态的鲁棒性。
summary_zh: 我们将机器人在无GPS室内环境中的定位问题重新定义为语义推理任务，而非几何估计问题。受人类利用物体级线索与标注地图进行定位的启发，我们探究当给定前置摄像头图像、极坐标激光雷达扫描数据及俯视语义网格地图时，视觉语言模型能否推断出机器人位姿。我们采用LoRA微调Qwen2.5-VL-7B模型，并附加轻量级回归头，直接从最终隐藏状态预测连续位姿坐标（x, y, theta），绕过文本生成过程。训练采用复合位置-方向损失函数，结合课程学习策略，在包含120,112个样本及527个场景的自定义Gazebo数据集上进行。在18,017个样本的分布内测试集上，模型实现了98.23%的位置精度、98.00%的方向精度、96.75%的完整位姿精度，平均位置误差0.11米，平均方向误差5.7度，单样本处理时间0.62秒。面对七种未见物体类别时，位置精度仅下降7.2个百分点，达到90.99%，验证了模型依赖语义空间推理而非外观记忆。在残缺地图场景下，微调可将位置精度恢复至93.72%，展现对过时或局部地图信息的适应性。两项消融实验揭示了跨模态互补性：移除激光雷达仅使用摄像头与地图输入时，位置精度仍达95.06%，仅比完整系统低3.2个百分点；但当摄像头面对墙壁视野无可见物体时，激光雷达可将位置精度维持在92.33%，而两者皆缺失时精度骤降至70.74%。这表明在摄像头语义信息缺失时，激光雷达成为主要定位信号，并在遮挡或稀疏布局下提供可靠的备用方案。

title: Human-Centric Transferable Tactile Pre-Training for Dexterous Robotic Manipulation
summary: As an essential modality for dexterous and contact-rich tasks, tactile sensing provides precise force feedback that cannot be reliably inferred from vision. However, limited by hardware and data collection systems, existing datasets with tactility remain small in scale and narrow in contact coverage. Meanwhile, Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models with tactile modality are constrained on dynamics-agnostic post-training, which limits the performance ceiling on downstream tasks. In this paper, we present H-Tac, a large-scale tactile-action dataset with 160-hour egocentric human videos containing more than 300 tasks and 135k episodes. Building upon this, we propose Transferable Tactile Pre-Training (TTP), a system of tactile-based pre-training on human data for fine-grained robotic tasks. To bridge the gap between humans and robots, we use unified tactile and action spaces throughout the pre-training and post-training phases, preserving prior knowledge during human-to-robot transfer. By leveraging a tactile expert for future tactile prediction, our framework explicitly models the contact dynamics and precise physical interactions. Extensive experiments in simulation and on real robots demonstrate that our model achieves superior performance, exhibiting robust generalization and fine-grained manipulation capabilities. TTP paves the way for scalable tactile pre-training via human-to-robot transfer.
tldr: This paper introduces H-Tac, a large-scale tactile-action dataset from human video, and TTP, a transferable tactile pre-training framework that unifies tactile and action spaces for human-to-robot transfer, achieving robust generalization and fine-grained dexterous manipulation.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了H-Tac，一个基于人类视频的大规模触觉-动作数据集，以及TTP，一个可迁移的触觉预训练框架，通过统一触觉和动作空间实现人机迁移，在灵巧操作任务上展现出强大的泛化能力和精细控制性能。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
作为灵巧且高接触依赖型任务的关键感知模态，触觉传感能够提供无法通过视觉可靠推断的精确力反馈。然而，受限于硬件与数据采集系统，现有含触觉模态的数据集规模较小且接触覆盖范围狭窄。同时，融合触觉模态的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型局限于忽略动力学特性的后训练阶段，这限制了其在下游任务中的性能上限。本文提出H-Tac——包含160小时第一人称人类视频的大规模触觉-动作数据集，涵盖300余种任务及135,000条任务片段。基于此，我们提出可迁移触觉预训练（TTP）系统，该系统通过人类数据上的触觉预训练实现细粒度机器人任务。为弥合人类与机器人间的差距，我们在预训练与后训练阶段均采用统一的触觉与动作空间，从而在人类到机器人的迁移过程中保留先验知识。通过引入触觉专家模型进行未来触觉预测，我们的框架显式建模了接触动力学与精确物理交互。仿真与实体机器人上的大量实验表明，本模型展现出卓越性能、强泛化能力及细粒度操控能力。TTP为通过人类到机器人迁移实现可扩展触觉预训练开辟了新路径。

title: RoboWorld: Fast and Reliable Neural Simulators for Generalist Robot Policy Evaluation
summary: Video world models are emerging as a scalable alternative for evaluating generalist robot policies, bypassing the physical constraints and engineering burdens of real-world deployment. However, evaluating policies with video world models remains challenging, as world-model errors can make generated rollouts unreliable and slow inference limits large-scale throughput. We introduce RoboWorld, an automated evaluation pipeline that pairs a fast autoregressive video world model with a task-progress-aware vision-language model scoring. To enable reliable long-horizon autoregressive world-model rollouts, we propose Step Forcing, which combines anchored and one-step self-forwarded contexts to reduce train--test mismatch while preserving action--observation dynamics. Together, these components enable RoboWorld to align strongly with real-world robot evaluation across tasks and environments, achieving Pearson's r = 0.989 and Spearman's \r{ho} = 0.970.
tldr: RoboWorld introduces an automated evaluation pipeline combining a fast autoregressive video world model with Step Forcing to reduce train-test mismatch, paired with a task-progress-aware VLM scoring, enabling reliable and aligned robot policy evaluation.
tldr_zh: RoboWorld 提出了一种自动化评估流程，结合快速自回归视频世界模型和 Step Forcing 以减少训练-测试不匹配，并搭配任务进度感知的视觉语言模型评分，实现可靠且与现实对齐的机器人策略评估。
summary_zh: 视频世界模型正成为一种可扩展的替代方案，用于评估通用型机器人策略，从而绕开现实部署中的物理约束与工程负担。然而，利用视频世界模型评估策略仍面临挑战：世界模型误差可能导致生成的轨迹不可靠，而缓慢的推理速度则限制了大规模吞吐量。我们提出RoboWorld——一个自动化评估流水线，该流水线将快速自回归视频世界模型与具备任务进度感知能力的视觉语言模型评分模块相结合。为实现可靠的长期自回归世界模型轨迹生成，我们提出“步骤强制”机制，该机制通过融合锚定上下文与单步自回归上下文，在保持动作-观测动态特性的同时减少训练-测试不匹配问题。这些组件共同使RoboWorld能够在不同任务与环境场景下与现实机器人评估结果高度对齐，皮尔逊相关系数达0.989，斯皮尔曼等级相关系数达0.970。

title: AutoSpeed: Annotation-Free Stage-Adaptive Motion Speed Learning for Robot Manipulation
summary: Different stages of manipulation tasks exhibit varying levels of difficulty, suggesting stage-dependent motion speeds and temporal prediction horizons. However, existing IL-based visuomotor policies typically imitate the execution speed of expert demonstrations and operate with a fixed temporal prediction horizon, limiting flexibility and overall task throughput. In this paper, we introduce AutoSpeed, a model-agnostic learning framework that enables existing visuomotor policies to predict trajectories with stage-adaptive motion speeds, without requiring speed or stage annotations. We treat future trajectories at different speeds as candidate optimization targets, evaluate each candidate using a composite cost that trades off prediction error against prediction horizon, and optimize the policy toward the minimum-cost candidate. With a fixed-length action sequence, speed modulation adjusts the effective temporal prediction horizon: simple stages are executed faster with a longer prediction horizon, whereas complex stages are executed more slowly with a shorter prediction horizon. Specifically, we implement speed modulation in the frequency domain via the discrete cosine transform (DCT), which enables smooth, non-integer speed scaling and thus preserves motion continuity. Extensive evaluations show that AutoSpeed substantially reduces task execution time while also improving success rates. Under the AutoSpeed framework, the inferred motion speeds exhibit a strong correspondence with task stages.
tldr: This paper introduces AutoSpeed, a model-agnostic framework that enables existing visuomotor policies to predict trajectories with stage-adaptive motion speeds by optimizing over candidate speeds in the frequency domain, reducing task execution time and improving success rates without needing speed or stage annotations.
tldr_zh: 本文提出AutoSpeed，一种与模型无关的框架，使现有视觉运动策略能够预测具有阶段自适应运动速度的轨迹，通过频域中的候选速度优化，在不需速度或阶段标注的情况下减少任务执行时间并提高成功率。
summary_zh: 操作任务的不同阶段表现出不同的难度，提示着阶段相关的运动速度和时间预测范围。然而，现有的基于模仿学习的视觉运动策略通常模仿专家演示的执行速度，并以固定的时间预测范围运行，这限制了灵活性和整体任务吞吐量。本文提出AutoSpeed，一种与模型无关的学习框架，使现有视觉运动策略能够预测具有阶段自适应运动速度的轨迹，且无需速度或阶段标注。我们将不同速度下的未来轨迹视为候选优化目标，利用权衡预测误差与预测范围的复合代价评估每个候选方案，并推动策略向最小代价候选方向优化。通过固定长度的动作序列，速度调制可调整有效时间预测范围：简单阶段以更长的预测范围更快执行，而复杂阶段则以更短的预测范围更慢执行。具体而言，我们通过离散余弦变换（DCT）在频域中实现速度调制，该变换支持平滑的非整数速度缩放，从而保持运动连续性。广泛评估表明，AutoSpeed显著减少了任务执行时间，同时提高了成功率。在AutoSpeed框架下，推断出的运动速度与任务阶段呈现强对应关系。

title: ABot-M0.5: Unified Mobility-and-Manipulation World Action Model
summary: Mobile manipulation is a key capability for general-purpose robots, yet remains challenging for current embodied learning methods. VLA policies are typically reactive and lack explicit world modeling, while existing World Action Models (WAMs) are still poorly aligned with the structure of mobile manipulation: they operate on coarse video chunks, model entangled navigation-manipulation actions, and train inverse dynamics under supervision that does not match autoregressive inference. As a result, they often miss fine-grained contact dynamics, suffer from action-distribution conflicts, and accumulate errors over long-horizon rollouts. We propose ABot-M0.5, a new WAM built on the insight that mobile manipulation requires alignment at three levels: temporal granularity, action space, and train-test consistency. To align temporal granularity, we introduce intermediate latent actions that capture local visual state transitions and serve as an bridging action space between video latents and embodiment-specific controls. To align action space, we design a dual-level Mixture-of-Transformers architecture that disentangles both modality representations and heterogeneous action subspaces such as base movement and arm manipulation. To align inference conditions, we propose the dream-forcing training strategy that progressively trains inverse dynamics on model-predicted videos, improving train-test alignment and robustness during autoregressive prediction. Experiments on challenging mobile and fine-grained manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that ABot-M0.5 achieves state-of-the-art performance in both long-horizon task success and finegrained control accuracy. These results highlight the critical importance of granularity-aligned, action-disentangled, and inference-consistent world-action modeling.
tldr: ABot-M0.5 proposes a unified World Action Model for mobile manipulation with aligned temporal granularity, disentangled action spaces, and consistent train-test inference, achieving state-of-the-art performance on long-horizon and fine-grained tasks.
tldr_zh: ABot-M0.5 提出了一种面向移动操作任务的统一世界动作模型，通过对齐时间粒度、解耦动作空间和保持训练-测试推断一致性，在长时域和精细操控任务中达到了最优性能。
summary_zh: 移动操作是通用机器人的关键能力，但目前对具身学习方法仍构成挑战。视觉-语言-动作（VLA）策略通常是被动响应的，缺乏显式世界建模。现有的世界动作模型（WAM）仍与移动操作的结构存在偏差：它们基于粗粒度的视频片段运行，对导航与操作动作进行耦合建模，并在与自回归推理不匹配的监督条件下训练逆动力学模型。因此，这类模型常缺失细粒度接触动力学特征，遭遇动作分布冲突，并在长时程任务中累积误差。我们提出ABot-M0.5——一种新型WAM，其构建基于核心洞察：移动操作需要在三个层级实现对齐——时间粒度、动作空间、以及训练-测试一致性。为对齐时间粒度，我们引入中间潜在动作，用于捕捉局部视觉状态转移，并作为视频潜在表征与具身控制指令之间的桥接动作空间。为对齐动作空间，我们设计双层混合变换器架构，实现模态表征与异构动作子空间（如基座移动与机械臂操作）的解耦。为对齐推理条件，我们提出“梦想强制”（dream-forcing）训练策略，在模型预测的视频上渐进训练逆动力学模型，从而提升自回归预测中训练-测试对齐度与鲁棒性。在具挑战性的移动操作与细粒度操作基准测试中，ABot-M0.5在长时程任务成功率与细粒度控制精度上均达到最优性能。这些结果凸显了粒度对齐、动作解耦与推理一致性世界动作建模的关键重要性。

title: Domain Arithmetic: One-Shot VLA Adaptation under Environmental Shifts
summary: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models often fail to perform the same learned tasks under environmental shifts, such as changes in camera pose and shifts to a different but similar robot (e.g., from Panda to UR5e). Adapting these models to the shifted environment (i.e., target domain) often requires training on multiple demonstrations for each task, which are costly to collect. To reduce the burden of data curation and training, we propose an analogy-based method that adapts VLA models under environmental shifts through weight vector arithmetic with domain-specific information addition, named Domain ARiThmetic (DART). Unlike prior approaches, DART requires collecting only a single demonstration, enabling efficient adaptation. To accurately isolate domain-specific information for addition, DART performs subspace alignment between singular components in weight vectors to filter out noisy components. In both simulated and real-world experiments, DART outperforms existing VLA adaptation methods in one-shot scenarios across diverse visual and embodiment shifts. Code is available at https://github.com/snumprlab/dart.
tldr: DART adapts VLA models to new environments with a single demonstration via weight vector arithmetic and subspace alignment, outperforming existing methods in one-shot scenarios.
tldr_zh: DART通过权重向量算术和子空间对齐，仅需一次演示即可将VLA模型适应新环境，在单样本场景中优于现有方法。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在环境变化（如相机位姿改变、迁移至不同但相似的机器人平台，例如从Panda机器人切换至UR5e机器人）时，往往无法执行已学会的相同任务。将此类模型适配至变化后的环境（即目标域）通常需要为每个任务收集大量示范数据，而此类数据的采集成本高昂。为减轻数据整理与训练负担，我们提出了一种基于类比的方法，通过权重向量算术运算与领域特定信息相加来实现VLA模型在环境变化下的适配，该方法名为领域算术（DART）。与现有方法不同，DART仅需收集单个示范即可实现高效适配。为精确分离待添加的领域特定信息，DART对权重向量中的奇异分量进行子空间对齐，以滤除噪声分量。在仿真与真实世界实验中，DART在跨视觉与具身迁移的单样本场景下均优于现有VLA适配方法。代码已开源：https://github.com/snumprlab/dart。

title: Learning Gait-Aware Quadruped Locomotion with Temporal Logic Specifications
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) for quadruped locomotion commonly depends on fixed, hand-crafted, and Markovian reward functions that limit both interpretability of learned policies and lack explicit control over gait behaviors. We introduce a framework where distinct gaits are specified using parameterized constraints expressed in Signal Temporal Logic (STL). These include safety bounds, gait synchronization constraints, command tracking, and actuation bounds. From these specifications, we develop a reward shaping mechanism that provides learning agents a dense, continuous reward landscape that encodes desired behavior. We define parametric STL templates for three speed regimes (walking-trot, trot, bound), calibrate their parameters from reference rollouts, and compute rewards from using smooth approximations of STL robustness over the rollouts. The generated rewards can be used to provide shaped gradients compatible with Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO). We instantiate the approach on Google's Barkour quadruped robot in MuJoCo XLA (MJX). We use parallelization within the simulator to improve training speeds and use domain randomization to robustify learned policies. We show that compared to a baseline of hand-crafted rewards, the STL-shaped rewards yield tighter velocity tracking and more stable training. Videos can be found on our project website: https://stl-locomotion.github.io/.
tldr: This paper introduces a framework that uses Signal Temporal Logic (STL) to specify gait parameters and shapes dense reward functions for reinforcement learning-based quadruped locomotion, achieving improved velocity tracking and training stability on a real robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一个框架，利用信号时序逻辑指定步态参数并构建稠密奖励函数，用于强化学习驱动的四足机器人运动，在真实机器人上实现了更优的速度跟踪和训练稳定性。
summary_zh: 四足机器人运动控制中的强化学习通常依赖于固定、手工设计的马尔可夫奖励函数，这既限制了学习策略的可解释性，又缺乏对步态行为的显式控制。我们提出一种框架，利用信号时序逻辑中表达的参数化约束来指定不同步态，包括安全边界、步态同步约束、指令跟踪以及驱动边界。基于这些规范，我们开发了一种奖励塑形机制，为学习智能体提供包含期望行为的稠密连续奖励分布。我们定义了三种速度模式（慢跑-小跑、小跑、跳跃）的参数化STL模板，通过参考轨迹校准其参数，并利用轨迹上STL鲁棒性的平滑近似来计算奖励。生成的奖励可用于提供与近端策略优化算法兼容的塑形梯度。我们在MuJoCo XLA中的谷歌Barkour四足机器人上实现了该方法，利用仿真器并行化加速训练，并通过域随机化增强习得策略的鲁棒性。结果表明，与手工设计奖励的基准方法相比，STL塑形奖励能实现更精准的速度跟踪和更稳定的训练。视频可在项目网站查看：https://stl-locomotion.github.io/。

title: Unleashing More Actions via Action Compositional Training for VLA Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action models excel at robotic manipulation, driven by the scale and diversity of demonstration data. However, standard training paradigms often cause VLA models to severely overfit to specific behavioral patterns, rendering them unable to generalize to out-of-distribution scenarios even when those scenarios merely require novel combinations of identical sub-skills. While expanding datasets can mitigate this overfitting, acquiring high-quality robot data remains notoriously labor-intensive and cost-prohibitive. To resolve this impasse without expensive human teleoperation and to truly unleash more actions,i.e., enable VLA models to compose known sub-skills into a much broader set of executable behaviors beyond the original demonstrations-we propose ACT-VLA (Action Compositional Training for VLA Models), an offline data augmentation framework that leverages the model's latent task representations to synthesize novel, physically valid demonstrations directly from existing tasks for policy training. By eliminating additional manual data collection, our method automatically expands the training distribution and mitigates overfitting. We evaluate our approach on challenging manipulation tasks in simulation. Experiments demonstrate that while baseline VLA models generalize poorly due to original distribution overfitting, policies trained with our synthesized data achieve substantially higher success rates, validating that leveraging existing tasks for automated demonstration synthesis provides an effective, scalable, and data-efficient route to broadening VLA generalization.
tldr: Proposes ACT-VLA, an offline data augmentation framework that synthesizes novel, physically valid demonstrations from existing tasks by leveraging the model's latent task representations, enabling VLA models to compose known sub-skills into broader behaviors without additional human teleoperation.
tldr_zh: 提出ACT-VLA，一种离线数据增强框架，利用模型潜在任务表示从现有任务中合成新颖的物理有效演示，使VLA模型能够将已知子技能组合成更广泛的行为，无需额外人类遥操作。
summary_zh: 视觉-语言-动作模型在机器人操作任务中表现出色，这得益于演示数据的规模与多样性。然而，标准训练范式常导致VLA模型严重过拟合于特定行为模式，使其无法泛化到分布外场景——即使这些场景仅需相同子技能的新颖组合。虽然扩展数据集可缓解此类过拟合，但获取高质量机器人数据仍以人力密集和成本高昂著称。为突破这一僵局（无需昂贵的人类遥操作），并真正释放更多动作（即让VLA模型能将已知子技能组合为远超原始演示的可执行行为集合），我们提出ACT-VLA（VLA模型动作组合训练框架），这是一个离线数据增强框架，通过利用模型的潜在任务表征，直接从现有任务中合成新颖且物理可行的演示数据用于策略训练。该方法无需额外人工数据采集，可自动扩展训练分布并缓解过拟合。我们在仿真环境中对具有挑战性的操作任务进行了评估。实验表明：当基线VLA模型因原始分布过拟合而泛化能力低下时，采用我们合成数据训练的策略实现了显著更高的成功率——这验证了利用现有任务进行自动演示合成，为拓展VLA泛化能力提供了一条高效、可扩展且数据利用率高的路径。

title: NeHMO: Neural Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability Learning for Decentralized Safe Multi-Arm Motion Planning
summary: Safe multi-arm motion planning is a challenging problem in robotics due to its high dimensionality, coupled configuration space, and complex collision constraints. Centralized planners are capable of coordinating all arms but often face scalability limitations, restricting applicability in real-time settings. On the other hand, decentralized methods are scalable and recent deep learning-based approaches have shown promising results. However, these depend on accurate behavior prediction or coordination protocols and may fail when other arms act unpredictably. To address these challenges, we introduce a neural Hamilton-Jacobi Reachability (HJR) learning-based approach to approximate a safety value function that captures worst-case inter-arm safety constraints. We further develop a decentralized trajectory optimization framework that uses the learned HJR representation for real-time planning. The proposed method is scalable and data-efficient, generalizes across multi-manipulator systems, and outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on challenging multi-arm motion planning tasks.
tldr: This paper proposes a neural Hamilton-Jacobi reachability learning framework for decentralized safe multi-arm motion planning, approximating a safety value function to enable real-time trajectory optimization and improve scalability.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于神经哈密顿-雅可比可达性学习的分布式安全多臂运动规划方法，通过近似安全值函数实现实时轨迹优化并提升可扩展性。
summary_zh: 多臂安全运动规划是机器人领域的一项挑战性问题，其难点在于高维度、耦合构型空间以及复杂的碰撞约束。集中式规划器虽能协调所有机械臂，但常面临可扩展性瓶颈，限制了其在实时场景中的应用。相比之下，分布式方法具备可扩展性，近期基于深度学习的方法也展现出良好前景。然而，这类方法依赖精确的行为预测或协调协议，当其他机械臂动作不可预测时可能失效。针对这些挑战，我们提出一种基于神经哈密顿-雅可比可达性（HJR）学习的方法，通过近似安全价值函数来表征最坏情况下的臂间安全约束。进一步，我们开发了基于所学HJR表示的分布式轨迹优化框架，用于实时规划。该方法兼具可扩展性与数据高效性，能跨多机械臂系统泛化，并在挑战性多臂运动规划任务中超越现有最优基线方法。

title: ASPIRE: Agentic /Skills Discovery for Robotics
summary: Traditional robot programming is challenging: it requires orchestrating multimodal perception, managing physical contact dynamics, and handling diverse configurations and execution failures. We introduce ASPIRE (Agentic Skill Programming through Iterative Robot Exploration), a continual learning system that autonomously writes and refines robot control programs in a code-as-policy paradigm while compounding experience into a reusable skill library. ASPIRE discovers skills that persist across tasks, simulation and real-world settings, and embodiments. It operates in an open-ended loop with three components: (1) a closed-loop robot execution engine that exposes fine-grained multimodal traces, enabling autonomous failure diagnosis, repair synthesis, and validation; (2) a continually expanding skill library that distills validated fixes into reusable, transferable knowledge; and (3) evolutionary search that generates diverse task sequences and control programs to explore beyond single-trajectory refinement. ASPIRE surpasses prior methods by up to 77% on LIBERO-Pro manipulation under perturbation, 72% on Robosuite bimanual handover, and 32% on BEHAVIOR-1K long-horizon household tasks. Its accumulated library also enables zero-shot generalization to unseen long-horizon tasks: on LIBERO-Pro Long, ASPIRE achieves 31% success versus 4% for prior methods despite their use of test-time reasoning and retries. Finally, simulation-discovered skills provide initial evidence of sim-to-real transfer, substantially reducing real-robot programming effort across different embodiments and robot APIs.
tldr: ASPIRE introduces a closed-loop continual learning system that autonomously writes and refines robot control programs by compounding experience into a reusable skill library, demonstrating significant improvements on manipulation benchmarks and initial sim-to-real transfer.
tldr_zh: ASPIRE提出了一种闭环持续学习系统，能够自主编写和优化机器人控制程序，并将经验积累为可复用的技能库，在多个操作基准上取得显著提升并初步实现仿真到现实的迁移。
summary_zh: 传统机器人编程面临诸多挑战：需要协调多模态感知、管理物理接触动力学、处理多样化配置及执行故障。本文提出ASPIRE（基于迭代机器人探索的智能技能编程系统）——一种持续学习系统，采用“代码即策略”范式自主编写与改进机器人控制程序，同时将累积经验转化为可复用的技能库。ASPIRE能够发现跨任务、跨仿真与真实环境、跨机器人形态的持久性技能。该系统通过开放式闭环架构运行，包含三个核心组件：（1）闭环机器人执行引擎，可生成细粒度多模态轨迹，实现自主故障诊断、修复方案合成与验证；（2）持续扩展的技能库，将验证后的修复方案提炼为可复用、可迁移的知识；（3）进化搜索机制，通过生成多样化任务序列与控制程序，突破单一轨迹优化的限制。在扰动条件下，ASPIRE在LIBERO-Pro操作任务中性能较先前方法提升77%，在Robosuite双臂交接任务中提升72%，在BEHAVIOR-1K长时域家务任务中提升32%。其累积技能库还可实现未见长时域任务的零样本泛化：在LIBERO-Pro Long任务中，ASPIRE成功率达31%，而先前方法即便使用测试时推理与重试机制也仅达4%。此外，仿真环境发现的技能首次验证了从仿真到真实（sim-to-real）的迁移能力，显著降低了不同机器人形态与API条件下的真实机器人编程工作量。

title: ELMP: Efficient Learning for Motion Planning via Analytical Policy Gradients
summary: Neural Motion Planners (NMPs) enable fast reactive motion generation, but adapting them to new environments typically requires recollecting large expert datasets, which is computationally prohibitive. We propose ELMP, a framework for data-efficient adaptation via self-supervised fine-tuning. Rather than generating additional expert trajectories with expensive global planners, ELMP directly optimizes the policy through a differentiable kinematic layer using dense collision, target-reaching, and smoothness objectives. This replaces expert data generation with rapid problem sampling, reducing per-sample adaptation cost by roughly two orders of magnitude. To further support robust generalization across changing kinematic chains, we introduce a mechanism to explicitly encode tool geometry via point clouds. Benchmarked against classical and neural baselines, ELMP achieves an 84.8% average success rate with orders-of-magnitude lower cold-start latency than classical methods. In unseen environments, self-supervised fine-tuning improves success rate from 57.3% (zero-shot) to 89.8%, removing the data collection bottleneck. Our approach maintains millisecond-level inference latency and is validated on a physical Franka Emika Panda robot.
tldr: ELMP enables data-efficient adaptation of neural motion planners via self-supervised fine-tuning with differentiable kinematics and dense objectives, replacing costly expert data generation with rapid problem sampling.
tldr_zh: ELMP 通过可微运动学层和密集目标函数实现自监督微调，以高效适应新环境，替代昂贵的专家数据生成。
summary_zh: 神经运动规划器（NMPs）能够实现快速的反应式运动生成，但将其适配至新环境通常需要重新收集大规模专家数据集，这在计算上代价高昂。我们提出ELMP框架，通过自监督微调实现数据高效的适配。ELMP不依赖昂贵的全局规划器生成额外专家轨迹，而是通过可微运动学层，利用密集碰撞、目标到达和平滑度目标直接优化策略。该方法以快速问题采样替代专家数据生成，将单样本适配成本降低约两个数量级。为支持运动链变化场景下的稳健泛化，我们引入通过点云显式编码工具几何结构的机制。与经典及神经基线方法的对比测试表明，ELMP实现了84.8%的平均成功率，冷启动延迟比经典方法低数个数量级。在未见环境中，自监督微调将成功率从57.3%（零样本）提升至89.8%，消除了数据采集瓶颈。本方法保持毫秒级推理延迟，并在实体Franka Emika Panda机器人上完成验证。

title: 3D Point World Models: Point Completion Enables More Accurate Dynamics Learning
summary: Learning predictive models of the world enables robotic control through planning, potentially allowing robots to improvise solutions on new tasks. However, large video-based dynamics models lack explicit 3D spatial structure and suffer from geometrically inconsistent long-term rollouts with compounding errors. Emerging 3D dynamics models based on partial point clouds improve geometric consistency but remain sensitive to occlusions and accumulated prediction drift. To address these challenges, we present 3D Point World Models (3DPWM) - a task-agnostic world model that operates entirely in 3D space by first completing partial point clouds and then learning action-conditioned dynamics in this completed 3D scene. By operating on completed geometry, 3DPWM enables reliable long-horizon rollouts and more accurate cost evaluation for model-based planning while supporting adaptation to new tasks. Experiments across different robotic embodiments and tabletop manipulation benchmarks demonstrate that 3DPWM achieves significantly more reliable long-horizon rollouts (100-300+ steps), supports both open-loop and closed-loop planning, and enables successful sim-to-real transfer.
tldr: 3DPWM learns action-conditioned dynamics over completed 3D point clouds, enabling geometrically consistent long-horizon rollouts for model-based robotic planning across embodiments and tasks.
tldr_zh: 3DPWM 通过在完整的3D点云上学习动作条件动力学，实现了几何一致的长时域 rollout，并支持跨机器人形态和任务的模型预测规划。
summary_zh: 学习预测世界模型可以通过规划实现机器人控制，使机器人能够即兴为新任务设计解决方案。然而，基于视频的大规模动力学模型缺乏明确的3D空间结构，且会在长期推演中因误差累积而产生几何不一致的问题。新兴的基于部分点云的3D动力学模型虽然改善了几何一致性，但仍对遮挡和累积预测漂移敏感。为应对这些挑战，我们提出3D点云世界模型（3DPWM）——一种完全在3D空间运行的任务无关世界模型。该模型首先补全部分点云，随后在此完整3D场景中学习动作条件动力学。通过基于完整几何结构运行，3DPWM能够实现可靠的长期推演，并为基于模型的规划提供更精确的成本评估，同时支持对新任务的适应。在不同机器人形态和桌面操作基准实验中的结果表明，3DPWM可显著提升长期推演的可靠性（100至300步以上），同时支持开环与闭环规划，并成功实现仿真到现实的迁移。

title: AD-MPCC: Adaptive Differentiable Model Predictive Contouring Control for Autonomous Racing
summary: This paper presents Adaptive Differentiable Model Predictive Contouring Control (AD-MPCC), a framework for autonomous racing that integrates differentiable MPCC with online parameter estimation to handle varying road-surface conditions. For online parameter estimation, we leverage a parameterized Pacejka Magic Formula together with a regularized moving-horizon estimation scheme with exponentially decaying weights to capture road interactions and update parameters in real time. Furthermore, we propose a differentiable MPCC (Diff-MPCC) framework that enables optimal adjustment of objective weights based on predefined long-horizon performance costs. To implement Diff-MPCC for online objective weight adaptation, we propose a Pacejka-informed machine learning model that is trained in a supervised manner using data generated by Diff-MPCC to tune the objective weights. Simulation results demonstrate that AD-MPCC reliably ensures safety and achieves faster lap times compared to baseline controllers in both single-surface and multiple-surface scenarios.
tldr: AD-MPCC integrates differentiable model predictive contouring control with online parameter estimation for autonomous racing, achieving faster lap times and safety under varying road conditions.
tldr_zh: AD-MPCC将可微模型预测轮廓控制与在线参数估计相结合用于自动驾驶赛车，在多变路面条件下实现了更快的圈速并保证了安全性。
summary_zh: 本文提出自适应可微分模型预测轮廓控制（AD-MPCC），该框架将可微分MPCC与在线参数估计相结合，用于处理自主赛车过程中变化的路面条件。在在线参数估计方面，我们利用参数化的Pacejka魔术公式，结合带有指数衰减权重的正则化滚动时域估计方案，实时捕捉路面相互作用并更新参数。此外，我们提出一种可微分MPCC（Diff-MPCC）框架，能够基于预定义的长时域性能代价对目标权重进行最优调整。为实现在线目标权重自适应，我们构建了一个基于Pacejka模型的机器学习模型，该模型采用Diff-MPCC生成的数据进行监督训练，以调节目标权重。仿真结果表明，与基线控制器相比，AD-MPCC在单路面及多路面场景下均能可靠地保障安全性，并实现更快的单圈用时。

title: Multi-scale Mixture of World Models for Embodied Agents in Evolving Environments
summary: Embodied agents operating in the real world require multi-scale reasoning and knowledge adaptation as conditions change. We identify two challenges in applying Mixture of Experts (MoE) to this setting: routing lacks an explicit notion of scale, preventing targeted updates at specific scales, and a uniform update policy cannot accommodate the different rates at which knowledge at each scale becomes outdated. We present MuSix, a framework that addresses both challenges through scale-aware world model mixture and evolution. A two-stage routing mechanism grounds scale selection in experiential distance, a measure of situational novelty inspired by Construal Level Theory: a meta-router first maps this quantity to a weight over continuous scale space, then per-scale base routers select world models within the identified scale. For adaptation, scale-dependent forgetting rates allow low-scale knowledge to refresh rapidly while high-scale abstractions persist, and gated inter-scale transfer maintains coherence across the hierarchy. Experiments on EmbodiedBench and HAZARD show that MuSix improves over state-of-the-art baselines on multi-scale reasoning and dynamic adaptation.
tldr: MuSix introduces scale-aware mixture of world models for embodied agents, using a two-stage routing mechanism and scale-dependent forgetting to handle multi-scale reasoning and dynamic environment adaptation.
tldr_zh: MuSix 提出了针对具身智能体的多尺度世界模型混合框架，通过两阶段路由机制和尺度相关遗忘策略，实现多尺度推理和动态环境适应。
summary_zh: 在现实世界中运行的具身智能体需要根据条件变化进行多尺度推理和知识适应。我们发现在此场景中应用混合专家模型面临两个挑战：路由机制缺乏明确的尺度概念，导致无法在特定尺度上进行针对性更新；同时，统一更新策略无法适应不同尺度知识更新速度的差异。为此，我们提出MuSix框架，通过尺度感知的世界模型混合与进化机制解决上述挑战。该框架采用两阶段路由机制：基于体验距离（一种受建构水平理论启发的情境新颖性度量）确定尺度选择，首先由元路由器将该度量映射至连续尺度空间的权重分布，随后各尺度的基础路由器在已识别尺度内选择世界模型。在适应方面，尺度相关的遗忘率使低尺度知识能够快速更新，而高尺度抽象知识得以持续保留，同时门控跨尺度传递机制维持层级间的一致性。在EmbodiedBench和HAZARD上的实验表明，MuSix在多尺度推理与动态适应任务上均优于当前最优基准方法。

title: SD-RouteFusion: Ego-Trajectory Prediction with SD-Map Route Conditioning
summary: This paper presents SD-RouteFusion, a deployable end-to-end ego-trajectory prediction method that fuses a front-facing camera, vehicle kinematics, and a navigation route derived from a Standard Definition (SD) map. Unlike approaches that rely on High Definition (HD) map geometry, SD-RouteFusion aligns the learning objective with scalable and production-ready SD-map route inputs, enabling route-aware prediction without requiring HD-map infrastructure. First, we demonstrate that SD-map route prior provides a powerful long-horizon semantic prior. Through a comprehensive study on a large-scale real-world dataset comprising 480k driving scenarios across 10 European countries and the U.S., we quantify the value of SD-route conditioning: incorporating SD-map routes yields a 10.5% ADE improvement over an image-and-kinematics baseline, while our full fusion strategy achieves a 16.9% ADE reduction given a prediction horizon of 8 seconds. The fusion strategy consists of a dual-hypothesis design paired with a gated classifier, to ensure robustness under route corruption and visual uncertainty. Finally, to support broader evaluation, we release an SD-route generation toolkit that enables SD-route-conditioned ego-trajectory prediction on all datasets containing ego pose and future trajectories. Together, SD-RouteFusion establishes a practical path toward robust, route-aware ego-trajectory prediction at scale.
tldr: SD-RouteFusion introduces an end-to-end ego-trajectory prediction method conditioned on SD-map routes, achieving significant accuracy improvements on a large-scale real-world driving dataset.
tldr_zh: SD-RouteFusion 提出了一种基于 SD 地图路线条件的端到端自车轨迹预测方法，在大规模真实驾驶数据集上实现了显著的精度提升。
summary_zh: 本文提出SD-RouteFusion，一种可部署的端到端自车轨迹预测方法，该方法融合前置摄像头、车辆运动学以及从标准精度地图（SD地图）中提取的导航路径。与依赖高精度地图（HD地图）几何信息的方法不同，SD-RouteFusion将学习目标与可扩展且面向生产的SD地图路径输入对齐，在无需HD地图基础设施的情况下实现路径感知预测。首先，我们证明SD地图路径先验能提供强大的长时域语义先验。通过在包含48万驾驶场景（覆盖10个欧洲国家及美国）的大规模真实世界数据集上的全面研究，我们量化了SD路径条件约束的价值：在8秒预测时域下，融入SD地图路径使基于图像与运动学基准的ADE（平均位移误差）降低10.5%，而完整融合策略使ADE降低16.9%。该融合策略采用双假设设计与门控分类器相结合，确保在路径干扰与视觉不确定性下的鲁棒性。最后，为支持更广泛的评估，我们发布了一套SD路径生成工具包，可在所有包含自车位姿与未来轨迹的数据集上实现SD路径条件约束的自车轨迹预测。综上，SD-RouteFusion为大规模鲁棒性路径感知自车轨迹预测开辟了可行路径。

title: ECoSim: Data Efficient Fine-Tuning for Controllable Traffic Simulation
summary: Controllable traffic simulation is critical for testing autonomous driving systems, yet existing approaches often require retraining large generative models with extensive annotated data. We introduce a lightweight control adaptation framework that enables multi-modal controllability (sketch, latent behavior codes, and text) for pretrained state-of-the-art diffusion and autoregressive traffic models. By modulating intermediate features through identity-initialized FiLM layers, our method efficiently adds new control modalities while preserving the base model's generative prior. Evaluated on Waymo Open Sim Agents Challenge, our approach demonstrates strong controllability with less than 1% of the paired control data. Through context-aware condition transfer, our framework enables counterfactual scenario generation and long-tail synthesis while maintaining stable closed-loop driving realism and safety. Our framework unlocks new possibilities for controllable traffic simulation, enabling targeted scenario generation through lightweight adaptation of pretrained generative models. Project page: https://ecosim-web.github.io/
tldr: ECoSim introduces a lightweight control adaptation framework that adds multi-modal controllability (sketch, latent behavior codes, text) to pretrained diffusion and autoregressive traffic models using identity-initialized FiLM layers, requiring less than 1% of paired control data and enabling counterfactual scenario generation and long-tail synthesis for autonomous driving simulation.
tldr_zh: ECoSim 提出了一种轻量级控制适配框架，通过身份初始化的 FiLM 层为预训练的扩散和自回归交通模型添加多模态可控性（草图、潜在行为代码和文本），仅需不到 1% 的配对控制数据，并支持自动驾驶模拟中的反事实场景生成和长尾合成。
summary_zh: 可控交通仿真对于自动驾驶系统的测试至关重要，但现有方法通常需要使用大量标注数据重新训练大规模生成模型。我们提出了一种轻量级控制适配框架，能够为预训练的最先进的扩散模型和自回归交通模型实现多模态可控性（手绘草图、潜在行为编码和文本）。通过经过恒等初始化的特征线性调制层调节中间特征，我们的方法在保留基础模型生成先验的同时高效添加了新的控制模态。在Waymo开放仿真智能体挑战赛上的评估表明，我们的方法使用不到1%的成对控制数据即可实现强大的可控性。通过上下文感知的条件迁移，我们的框架实现了反事实场景生成与长尾数据合成，同时保持稳定的闭环驾驶真实性与安全性。该框架通过轻量级适配预训练生成模型实现目标场景生成，为可控交通仿真开辟了新的可能性。项目页面：https://ecosim-web.github.io/

title: DriveVer: Lightweight Trajectory Evaluator as Test-Time Verifier for Autonomous Driving
summary: End-to-end autonomous driving models often encounter performance bottlenecks, as training-time scaling leads to high computational costs and diminishing marginal returns. Existing planners typically adopt a one-shot generation paradigm, lacking secondary validation and active correction mechanisms to detect and revise suboptimal or unsafe trajectories during inference. To address this issue, we propose DriveVer, a lightweight, plug-and-play Test-Time Verifier that leverages the test-time scaling paradigm to enable autonomous driving systems to validate and refine trajectories without costly and heavy training. We construct a dedicated trajectory dataset based on the NAVSIM benchmark through condition-driven clustering and balanced sampling according to ego-vehicle states and navigation commands. Employing a dual-head architecture, DriveVer efficiently fuses candidate trajectories with multi-view visual representations and ego-vehicle kinematic features to simultaneously predict a safety confidence score and an absolute geometric refinement vector. Extensive experiments on the NAVSIM benchmark show that DriveVer significantly improves the performance of base planning models. Notably, as an extremely compact model with only 34M parameters, DriveVer introduces minimal computational overhead, achieving competitive results while maintaining real-time inference efficiency.
tldr: DriveVer is a lightweight test-time verifier for autonomous driving that validates and refines one-shot trajectory predictions using a dual-head architecture to improve safety and performance with minimal computational overhead.
tldr_zh: DriveVer是一种轻量级的自动驾驶测试时验证器，通过双头架构验证和完善单次轨迹预测，以最小的计算开销提升安全性和性能。
summary_zh: 端到端自动驾驶模型常面临性能瓶颈，因其训练阶段的扩展计算成本高昂且边际收益递减。现有规划器通常采用单次生成范式，缺乏在推理过程中检测并修正次优或不安全轨迹的二次验证与主动修正机制。为此，我们提出DriveVer——一种轻量级即插即用的测试时验证器，通过利用测试时扩展范式，使自动驾驶系统能在无需昂贵且繁重训练的情况下验证与优化轨迹。我们基于NAVISIM基准，依据自车状态与导航指令，通过条件驱动聚类与平衡采样构建专用轨迹数据集。DriveVer采用双分支架构，高效融合候选轨迹、多视点视觉表征及自车运动学特征，同时预测安全置信度分数与绝对几何修正向量。在NAVISIM基准上的大量实验表明，DriveVer显著提升了基础规划模型的性能。值得注意的是，作为仅含34M参数的极紧凑模型，DriveVer在保持实时推理效率的同时，以极小计算开销实现了具有竞争力的结果。

title: Local Motion Matters: A Deconstruct-Recompose Paradigm for Reinforcement Learning Pre-training from Videos
summary: Pre-training on large-scale videos to improve reinforcement learning efficiency is promising yet remains challenging. Existing methods typically treat the agent as an indivisible entity, modeling motion patterns globally. Such global modeling is tightly coupled with the morphology, hindering transfer across domains. In contrast, despite the vast disparity in global motions, the local components exhibit similar motion patterns across different agents. Building on this insight, we propose a novel Deconstruct-Recompose Paradigm (DRP) for learning transferable local motion representations. Specifically, in the Deconstruct phase, we identify multiple local points and track their frame-wise motions, defining each as an Atomic Action. We introduce a Dual-Attention Encoder (DAE) to learn local motion representations from these Atomic Actions, capturing their spatiotemporal relationships. In the Recompose phase, we compose local motion representations with a learnable Motion Aggregation Token [MAT] via latent dynamics model learning. Additionally, an adapter bridges local motion and downstream action-specific dynamics to accelerate policy learning. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method effectively transfers to diverse robotic control and manipulation tasks, significantly improving sample efficiency and performance.
tldr: This paper proposes a Deconstruct-Recompose Paradigm (DRP) that decomposes video into local atomic actions, learns transferable local motion representations via a Dual-Attention Encoder, and recomposes them with a motion aggregation token to improve RL pretraining for robotic control and manipulation tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种解构-重组范式（DRP），通过将视频分解为局部原子动作，利用双注意力编码器学习可迁移的局部运动表示，并通过运动聚合令牌重组这些表示，从而提升机器人控制与操作任务的强化学习预训练效率。
summary_zh: 在大规模视频上进行预训练以提高强化学习效率具有广阔前景，但仍面临挑战。现有方法通常将智能体视为不可分割的整体，对其运动模式进行全局建模。这种全局建模与形态特征紧密耦合，阻碍了跨域迁移。相反，尽管全局运动存在巨大差异，不同智能体的局部组件却展现出相似的运动模式。基于这一发现，我们提出一种新颖的"解构-重组范式"（DRP），用于学习可迁移的局部运动表征。具体而言，在解构阶段，我们识别多个局部关键点并追踪其逐帧运动，将每个关键点定义为原子动作。我们引入双注意力编码器（DAE），从这些原子动作中学习局部运动表征，捕捉其时空关联。在重组阶段，我们通过潜在动力学模型学习，利用可学习的运动聚合令牌（MAT）组合局部运动表征。此外，适配器桥接局部运动与下游动作特异性动力学，以加速策略学习。大量实验表明，我们的方法能有效迁移至多样化的机器人控制与操作任务，显著提升样本效率与性能。

title: Sensorless Four-Channel Control Architecture Using Inverse Dynamics Modeling for Human-Scale Bilateral Teleoperation
summary: The four-channel teleoperation architecture is a well-established framework for achieving transparency in bilateral systems. However, its performance in human-scale teleoperation is limited by high inertia, modeling challenges, and reliance on noisy and costly force/torque sensors. This paper introduces a sensorless four-channel architecture based on inverse dynamics modeling. The controller is implemented and validated on a customized WAM bilateral teleoperation setup. Experiments demonstrate that the proposed approach outperforms conventional two- and four-channel schemes as well as transparency-enhancement methods, improving position and force tracking, reducing operator effort, and increasing maximum transmittable impedance without external sensors. A door-opening case study involving sustained whole-body contact along the manipulator further demonstrates the effectiveness of the method in realistic human-scale manipulation tasks.
tldr: This paper proposes a sensorless four-channel bilateral teleoperation architecture using inverse dynamics modeling, validated on a real human-scale WAM robot with improved force/position tracking and reduced operator effort.
tldr_zh: 本文提出一种基于逆动力学建模的无传感器四通道双边遥操作架构，在真实人尺度WAM机器人上验证，改善了力/位置跟踪并降低了操作员负担。
summary_zh: 四通道遥操作架构是实现双边系统透明性的成熟框架。然而，在人尺度遥操作中，其性能受限于高惯性、建模挑战以及对含噪且昂贵力/扭矩传感器的依赖。本文提出一种基于逆动力学建模的无传感器四通道架构。该控制器在定制化WAM双边遥操作平台上实现并验证。实验表明，所提方法优于传统的两通道与四通道方案及透明性增强方法，无需外部传感器即可提升位置与力追踪性能、降低操作者负担，并增大最大可传递阻抗。通过一项包含沿机械臂持续全身接触的门把手开启案例研究，进一步验证了该方法在真实人尺度操作任务中的有效性。

title: Towards Metric-Agnostic Trajectory Forecasting
summary: Accurate trajectory forecasting of surrounding traffic participants is a core capability for autonomous driving, enabling vehicles to anticipate behavior and plan safe maneuvers. We observe that current state-of-the-art forecasting models on Argoverse 2 and the Waymo Open Motion Dataset tailor their training objectives to the different benchmark metrics. Because these metrics encourage conflicting behavior, we propose a paradigm change for trajectory forecasting: training models with metric-agnostic probabilistic objectives and treating metric optimization as a downstream task applied to the predictive distribution. Concretely, we introduce Trajectory Distribution Evaluation (TraDiE) policies, metric-specific policies that map a predictive distribution to the set of $K$ trajectories and confidences required by trajectory forecasting metrics. We evaluate this framework by introducing DONUT-NLL, which adapts the training objective of the state-of-the-art trajectory forecasting model DONUT to directly optimize the predictive distribution. Using our policies, DONUT-NLL achieves state-of-the-art results on all metrics of the Waymo motion prediction benchmark.
tldr: Proposes a metric-agnostic training paradigm for trajectory forecasting, where models optimize a probabilistic objective and a downstream policy (TraDiE) converts the distribution into metric-specific outputs, achieving state-of-the-art results on the Waymo motion prediction benchmark.
tldr_zh: 提出了一种与度量无关的轨迹预测训练范式，模型优化概率目标，并通过下游策略（TraDiE）将预测分布转换为特定度量的输出，在Waymo运动预测基准上取得了最优结果。
summary_zh: 对周围交通参与者的精确轨迹预测是自动驾驶的核心能力，使车辆能够预测行为并规划安全操作。我们观察到，当前在Argoverse 2和Waymo开放运动数据集上表现最优的预测模型，其训练目标均针对不同的基准指标进行了定制化调整。由于这些指标会鼓励相互冲突的行为，我们提出轨迹预测的范式转变：使用与度量无关的概率目标训练模型，并将度量优化作为应用于预测分布的下游任务。具体而言，我们引入轨迹分布评估（TraDiE）策略——一种将预测分布映射至轨迹预测指标所需的K条轨迹及其置信度的度量专用策略。我们通过提出DONUT-NLL来验证该框架，该模型将最优轨迹预测模型DONUT的训练目标调整为直接优化预测分布。利用我们的策略，DONUT-NLL在Waymo运动预测基准的所有指标上均达到了最优结果。

title: FAR: Failure-Aware Retry for Test-Time Recovery and Continual Policy Improvement
summary: Robot policies inevitably encounter failures when deployed in real environments. Naive retries often repeat the same mistakes, while many existing recovery methods rely on human intervention. In this paper, we propose Failure-Aware Retry (FAR), a framework that enables robots to learn from previous failures at test time, adapt their behavior accordingly, and eventually complete the task autonomously. FAR combines Failure-Contrastive Preference Adaptation, which constructs preference learning data from failures to steer the policy away from previously unsuccessful behaviors, with lightweight action perturbations during retries to encourage local exploration. We further incorporate successful recovery trajectories into a training loop for continual policy improvement. Experiments in both simulation and real-world manipulation tasks show that FAR substantially improves success rates and robustness, with average gains of 17.6% over the standard diffusion policy in simulation and 11.7% in the real world. In addition, FAR significantly improves data efficiency under both reset and timestep budgets during continual policy improvement by exploiting informative failure cases.
tldr: FAR propose a framework that enables robots to learn from past failures at test time by combining failure-contrastive preference adaptation with local action perturbations, improving success rates and enabling continual policy improvement from recovery trajectories.
tldr_zh: FAR 提出一个框架，使机器人能够在测试时从过去的失败中学习，通过结合失败对比偏好适应和局部动作扰动，提高成功率并实现从恢复轨迹中持续改进策略。
summary_zh: 机器人策略在真实环境部署时不可避免地会遇到失败。简单的重试往往重复相同的错误，而现有许多恢复方法依赖人工干预。本文提出"失败感知重试"（FAR）框架，使机器人能在测试阶段从先前失败中学习，相应调整自身行为，最终自主完成任务。FAR融合了两项核心技术：失败对比偏好适配通过构建失败案例的偏好学习数据，引导策略规避先前未成功的行为模式；重试过程中的轻量动作扰动则鼓励局部探索。我们进一步将成功恢复轨迹纳入训练循环，实现策略的持续改进。在仿真与真实世界操作任务中的实验表明，FAR显著提升了成功率和鲁棒性，在仿真环境中相较于标准扩散策略平均提升17.6%，在真实场景中提升11.7%。此外，通过利用具有信息价值的失败案例，FAR在持续策略改进过程中显著提高了重置预算与时间步预算下的数据利用效率。

title: ROSA: A Robotics Foundation Model Serving System for Robot Factories
summary: Robotics foundation models (RFMs) are making general-purpose robots increasingly practical for factory deployments. While RFM serving systems are central to this vision, existing systems are largely shaped by a single-robot, single-model assumption: inference is treated as an edge-computing problem handled by an on-robot or dedicated nearby GPU, and the serving objective is to minimize the latency of a single action model. In this paper, we propose ROSA, an RFM serving system for robot factories designed around three key principles. First, ROSA adopts shared GPU-pool serving, allowing a fleet of robots to access powerful server-class GPUs over the network in order to improve inference performance, battery duration, and GPU utilization. Second, ROSA provides a robotics-aware programming abstraction and system design that supports multi-model pipelines, per-task performance requirements, and failure handling. Third, ROSA uses factory-objective-driven scheduling to maximize SLO-qualified factory productivity rather than minimizing individual request latency. We implement ROSA on top of Ray Serve for distributed orchestration, with vLLM, PyTorch, and JAX as model-serving backends, and evaluate it on both real robots and synthetic large-scale workloads. The results show that ROSA improves factory productivity by up to 12.06x over conventional dedicated serving systems.
tldr: ROSA is a serving system for robotics foundation models that enables a shared GPU pool to serve a fleet of factory robots, supporting multi-model pipelines, failure handling, and factory-objective-driven scheduling to improve productivity by up to 12x over dedicated per-robot GPU systems.
tldr_zh: ROSA是一个为机器人基础模型设计的服务系统，通过共享GPU池为工厂机器人集群提供服务，支持多模型流水线、故障处理和以工厂目标驱动的调度，相比专用GPU系统可将工厂生产效率提升多达12倍。
summary_zh: 机器人基础模型（RFM）正使通用机器人在工厂部署中日益实用化。尽管RFM服务系统是实现这一愿景的核心，但现有系统大多基于单机器人-单模型假设设计：推理过程被视为边缘计算问题，由机器人本地或专用近端GPU处理，服务目标则是最小化单一动作模型的延迟。本文提出ROSA——专为机器人工厂设计的RFM服务系统，其核心遵循三项原则。其一，ROSA采用共享GPU池服务模式，使机器人编队可通过网络访问强大的服务器级GPU，从而提升推理性能、延长电池续航并提高GPU利用率。其二，ROSA提供面向机器人领域的编程抽象与系统设计，支持多模型流水线、任务级性能需求及故障处理。其三，ROSA采用工厂目标驱动的调度策略，以最大化满足SLO要求的工厂生产力为目标，而非单纯降低个体请求延迟。我们在Ray Serve分布式编排框架上实现ROSA，并集成vLLM、PyTorch和JAX作为模型服务后端，在真实机器人与合成大规模负载场景下进行验证。实验表明，相比传统专用服务系统，ROSA可将工厂生产力提升高达12.06倍。

title: Robots Ask the Way: Communication-Enabled Social Navigation
summary:
Assistive autonomous robots operating in multi-agent environments require efficient strategies to locate specific individuals among multiple residents. Current social navigation methods focus on reactive collision avoidance and trajectory adaptation, but lack mechanisms to proactively gather information through human-robot communication.
  We introduce Communication-enabled Social Navigation (CommNav). In this novel task, robotic agents actively seek assistance from residents to locate target individuals by requesting information about recent sightings, locations, and movements.
  To evaluate CommNav, we extend Habitat 3.0 to create Habitat 3.0c, a communication-enabled variant supporting multi-human environments with information exchange protocols. Adding our communication module (COMM) to a state-of-the-art social navigation model yields a 10 percentage-point improvement in Episode Success. We further investigate the transition from structured data to natural language by evaluating models trained on LLM-generated instructions and on colloquial instructions collected from a human study.
  Our experiments reveal that: (i) explicit human-robot communication substantially enhances multi-person navigation performance; (ii) pre-training COMM on a communication pretext task effectively addresses the challenge of occasional interaction signals; and (iii) the navigation policy is highly robust to natural, colloquial human language, achieving an episode success statistically similar to the model using perfect structured data.
tldr: CommNav introduces communication-enabled social navigation, allowing robots to proactively ask humans for information to locate target individuals, achieving a 10% improvement in episode success.
tldr_zh: CommNav 提出了通信式社交导航，使机器人能够主动向人类询问信息以定位目标个体，任务成功率提高了10%。
summary_zh:
在多智能体环境中运行的辅助自主机器人需要高效策略，以在多名居民中定位特定个体。当前社交导航方法侧重于反应式碰撞规避与轨迹自适应，但缺乏通过人机通信主动收集信息的机制。

我们提出通信增强型社交导航（CommNav）。在该新任务中，机器人智能体通过请求近期目击信息、位置及移动轨迹等信息，主动向居民寻求协助以定位目标个体。

为评估CommNav，我们扩展Habitat 3.0创建了Habitat 3.0c——一种支持多人类环境及信息交换协议的通信增强型变体。将我们的通信模块（COMM）集成至先进社交导航模型后，任务成功率达到10个百分点的提升。我们进一步通过评估基于大语言模型生成的指令及人类研究中收集的口语化指令训练的模型，探究从结构化数据到自然语言的过渡。

实验结果表明：（i）显式人机通信显著提升多人导航性能；（ii）在通信预训练任务上对COMM进行预训练可有效应对偶发交互信号的挑战；（iii）导航策略对自然口语化人类语言具有高度鲁棒性，其任务成功率在统计上与使用完美结构化数据的模型无显著差异。

title: DART-VLN: Test-Time Memory Decay and Anti-Loop Regularization for Discrete Vision-Language Navigation
summary: Memory-based discrete vision-language navigation (VLN) agents must act under partial observability, yet even strong frozen backbones remain vulnerable at test time. Two common failure modes are stale historical evidence at memory readout and inefficient local backtracking during action selection. We present DART-VLN, a training-free test-time control framework for discrete VLN. DART-VLN combines Test-Time Memory Decay, a read-side memory reweighting rule that suppresses stale and redundant evidence without rewriting stored content, with Anti-Loop Regularization, a lightweight next-hop penalty that discourages immediate reversals during action selection. The framework introduces no new learnable parameters and leaves the learned backbone unchanged. Experiments on R2R and REVERIE show a consistent pattern: decay-only provides stable read-side gains, while decay+anti-loop achieves the best overall quality-efficiency trade-off, yielding shorter trajectories, lower runtime, and improved navigation performance in key settings. Behavioral analysis further confirms that anti-loop regularization reduces local backtracking and improves path efficiency under frozen backbones. Overall, the results show that modest test-time control can make memory-based discrete VLN more reliable and efficient without retraining.
tldr: DART-VLN proposes a training-free, test-time control framework for discrete VLN that combines memory decay to suppress stale evidence and anti-loop regularization to reduce backtracking, improving navigation efficiency without retraining.
tldr_zh: DART-VLN 提出了一种免训练、测试时控制的框架，通过记忆衰减抑制过时信息，并利用反循环正则化减少回溯，在无需重新训练的情况下提升了离散视觉语言导航的效率。
summary_zh: 基于记忆的离散视觉语言导航（VLN）智能体必须在部分可观测条件下运行，然而即便是强大的冻结主干网络在测试阶段仍然存在脆弱性。两种常见的失效模式为：记忆读取时历史证据陈旧，以及动作选择过程中局部回溯效率低下。我们提出DART-VLN——一种面向离散VLN的无训练测试时控制框架。该框架结合了测试时记忆衰减（一种读取侧记忆重加权规则，无需修改存储内容即可抑制陈旧与冗余证据）与反循环正则化（一种轻量级下一跳惩罚机制，用于在动作选择过程中抑制即时反向移动）。本框架不引入任何新的可学习参数，且保持已学习主干网络不变。在R2R和REVERIE数据集上的实验呈现一致规律：仅使用衰减机制可在读取侧获得稳定增益，而衰减与反循环正则化共同作用则实现了最优的质量-效率平衡，在关键场景中产生更短轨迹、更低运行时间及更优导航性能。行为分析进一步证实，反循环正则化在冻结主干网络条件下可减少局部回溯并提升路径效率。总体而言，实验结果表明，适度的测试时控制无需重新训练即可使基于记忆的离散VLN更加可靠且高效。

title: Beyond Line of Sight: Hybrid Validation of V2X Collective Perception in Complex Scenarios
summary: This paper introduces a probabilistic framework and hybrid validation methodology for V2X-enabled Collective Perception (CP) in complex traffic scenarios. The proposed Bayesian fusion algorithm extends the perceptual horizon of connected and autonomous vehicles by integrating heterogeneous sensor observations from multiple agents into a shared probabilistic occupancy grid. Each cell of this grid encapsulates both occupancy likelihood and uncertainty, enabling explainable and trustworthy situational awareness beyond the ego vehicle's field of view. To bridge the gap between simulation and real-world evaluation, a hybrid testing framework is developed, combining CARLA-based virtual environments with vehicle-in-the-loop experimentation. Experimental results in a roundabout scenario demonstrate a 260 percent increase in field-of-view coverage and a rise in occupied-cell recall from 0.82 (ego-only) to 0.94 (six-agent CP) under nominal localization conditions. Overall, the proposed approach provides a reproducible and interpretable foundation for validating CP systems, supporting the safe and certifiable deployment of cooperative autonomous vehicles.
tldr: This paper proposes a probabilistic Bayesian fusion framework and a hybrid validation methodology (CARLA + vehicle-in-the-loop) for V2X collective perception, significantly extending field-of-view coverage and occupancy recall in complex traffic scenarios.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种基于贝叶斯融合的概率框架和混合验证方法（CARLA仿真与实车在环实验结合），用于V2X集体感知，在复杂交通场景中显著扩展了视野覆盖范围并提高了占据格子召回率。
summary_zh: 本文提出了一种面向复杂交通场景中V2X集体感知的概率框架与混合验证方法。所提出的贝叶斯融合算法通过将多个智能体的异构传感器观测数据整合到共享概率占用网格中，扩展了网联自动驾驶汽车的感知范围。该网格中的每个单元同时包含占用可能性与不确定性信息，使得车辆能够在本车视野范围之外实现可解释且可信的态势感知。为弥合仿真与真实世界评估之间的差距，本文开发了一种融合基于CARLA虚拟环境与车辆在环实验的混合测试框架。在环岛场景下的实验结果表明：在标称定位条件下，视野覆盖率提升260%，占用单元召回率从0.82（单车感知）提升至0.94（六智能体集体感知）。总体而言，所提方法为验证集体感知系统提供了可复现、可解释的基础，支撑了合作式自动驾驶汽车的安全可认证部署。

title: From World Models to World Action Models: A Concise Tutorial for Robotics
summary: World models are increasingly used in embodied intelligence and generative simulation, yet their scope remains ambiguous across communities. This tutorial presents a design-space view of world models as action-conditioned predictive models that estimate the future evolution of task-relevant observations or states. We categorize existing methods into observation-space and state-space world models, comparing their trade-offs in visual fidelity, spatial structure, physical interpretability, and control usability. We further introduce world action models, which connect predicted futures with executable robot actions, and summarize four representative paradigms: imagine-then-execute, video-feature-conditioned action prediction, joint video-action modeling, and auxiliary video prediction for policy learning. The goal of this tutorial is to clarify the conceptual scope of world (action) models and provide a structured taxonomy for embodied prediction and control.
tldr: This tutorial provides a structured taxonomy of world models and world action models for robotics, categorizing methods by prediction space (observation vs. state) and control paradigms.
tldr_zh: 本教程为机器人学中的世界模型和世界动作模型提供了结构化分类，按预测空间（观测 vs. 状态）和控制范式对方法进行归类。
summary_zh: 世界模型在具身智能与生成式仿真中的应用日益广泛，但不同研究领域对其范畴的理解仍存在模糊性。本教程提出一种设计空间视角，将世界模型定义为基于动作条件的预测模型，用于估计与任务相关的观测或状态的未来演化。我们将现有方法划分为观测空间世界模型与状态空间世界模型两类，并从视觉保真度、空间结构、物理可解释性及控制可用性等维度比较其权衡特性。进一步地，我们引入世界动作模型——该模型将预测的未来状态与可执行的机器人动作相连接，并归纳出四种代表性范式：先想象后执行、视频特征条件动作预测、视频-动作联合建模，以及面向策略学习的辅助视频预测。本教程旨在厘清世界（动作）模型的概念边界，并为具身预测与控制提供结构化的分类体系。

title: Adaptive Companionship for Group-Following Robots: Handling Dynamically Changing Group Formations
summary: Accompanying a group of humans is an essential aspect of developing human-like social cognition in robots. However, human groups typically do not follow fixed formations, which poses significant challenges for robots in maintaining natural companionship behaviors. In this paper, we propose an adaptive group-accompaniment method for social robots based on Vision-Language Models (VLMs), leveraging their semantic reasoning capabilities to infer companion positions, maintain social distances, and understand group dynamics. The members of the group are first detected, and a perceptual module generates visual representations of the interaction group space as input to the VLM, which is then combined with a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) controller to ensure stability and safety. Experimental evaluations across five scenarios show that the proposed method enables robots to accompany the group effectively, demonstrating a 15\% improvement in success rate and a 25\% reduction in collision rate compared to baseline approaches. Additionally, a user study indicates that the generated companionship behaviors are perceived as natural and socially appropriate.
tldr: This paper presents an adaptive group-following method for social robots that uses a Vision-Language Model (VLM) to perceive group dynamics and a Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) controller for safe navigation, achieving improved success and reduced collision rates.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种用于社交机器人的自适应群体跟随方法，利用视觉语言模型感知群体动态，并结合模型预测路径积分控制器实现安全导航，在成功率和碰撞率上均有显著提升。
summary_zh: 陪伴人类群体是机器人类人社会化认知发展的关键环节。然而，人类群体通常不会遵循固定队形，这给机器人保持自然的陪伴行为带来了重大挑战。本文提出一种基于视觉-语言模型（VLM）的社交机器人自适应群体陪伴方法，利用其语义推理能力推断同伴位置、维持社交距离并理解群体动态。该方法首先检测群体成员，通过感知模块生成交互群体空间的视觉表征作为VLM输入，再结合模型预测路径积分（MPPI）控制器以确保稳定性与安全性。在五个场景中的实验评估表明，与基线方法相比，所提方法使机器人能够有效陪伴群体，成功率提升15%，碰撞率降低25%。此外，用户研究显示该方法生成的陪伴行为被认为具有自然性和社交适当性。

title: Creating Impactful Autonomous Driving Datasets: A Strategic Guide from Research Gap to Benchmark
summary: Well-designed autonomous driving datasets have fundamentally shaped research progress, yet existing literature primarily describes what datasets contain rather than how to strategically design impactful ones. This is especially limiting for small and medium-sized labs and startups that cannot afford to misallocate scarce resources. We argue that impactful dataset creation begins with a diagnosis: whether a research question is blocked by a data problem or an evaluation problem, and proceeds by selecting the minimal data operator(s) that closes the resulting gap, recording new data only when no cheaper operator(s) suffices. We analyze the evolution of major autonomous driving (AD) datasets through this lens and distill a strategic framework spanning gap identification, operator choice, sensor suite design, and annotation strategy. We ground the framework in a running case study of our KITScenes dataset family. The datasets are available at: https://kitscenes.com/
tldr: This paper presents a strategic framework for creating impactful autonomous driving datasets, focusing on diagnosing whether a research question is blocked by data or evaluation problems and selecting minimal data operators. It includes a case study of the KITScenes dataset family.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一个创建有影响力的自动驾驶数据集的战略框架，重点诊断研究问题是因数据问题还是评估问题受阻，并选择最小的数据操作符。文中还包括KITScenes数据集系列的案例研究。
summary_zh: 精心设计的自动驾驶数据集从根本上推动了研究进展，然而现有文献主要描述数据集包含什么内容，而非如何战略性地设计具有影响力的数据集。对于资源有限且无法承受错误分配的中小实验室和初创企业而言，这一局限尤为突出。我们认为，创建具有影响力的数据集始于诊断：即研究问题是被数据问题还是评估问题所阻碍，随后选择能够弥合该差距的最小数据操作手段，仅当没有更经济的操作手段时才记录新数据。我们通过这一视角分析了主流自动驾驶数据集的演变过程，并提炼出一个涵盖差距识别、操作手段选择、传感器套件设计及标注策略的战略框架。我们以KITScenes数据集系列作为贯穿性案例研究对该框架进行实证。数据集地址：https://kitscenes.com/

title: Path Planning in Physically Viable World Models
summary: Robots deployed in unstructured outdoor environments often plan from scene reconstructions collected before deployment because operators cannot remap large or remote sites before every mission. As a result, robots must make long-horizon planning decisions using stale maps that assume the terrain remains unchanged, even though physical changes to the environment may render previously feasible routes unsafe or unreachable at execution time. We present a physically viable world model for evaluating what-if queries for robot navigation under future terrain change. The system augments reconstructed 3D Gaussian splat scenes with physics-based simulation to generate physically modified versions of the same environment without recollecting sensor data or rebuilding the map. We then implement a terrain-aware planner that accounts for physical events, obstacles, and deformations that are simulated by the world model. This allows robots and human operators to evaluate whether planned routes remain feasible before committing to a planned route, particularly in constrained environments where retreat or recovery may become impossible once conditions change. We evaluate the system on a real outdoor field site in Central Texas using simulated flooding across multiple severity levels. We measure route and mission feasibility as terrain conditions deteriorate under physically simulated interventions. Our results show that physically viable world models expose long-horizon route failures and rerouting behavior that are not apparent when planning only on the original reconstructed environment, allowing robots to evaluate how future terrain changes may affect route feasibility before deployment.
tldr: The paper introduces a world model that augments 3D Gaussian splat reconstructions with physics simulation to evaluate robot navigation routes under future terrain changes, enabling long-horizon feasibility checks before deployment.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种世界模型，通过物理模拟增强3D高斯溅射重建，用于评估未来地形变化下的机器人导航路径可行性，允许在部署前检查长期路线是否可行。
summary_zh: 部署于非结构化室外环境的机器人，常依赖部署前采集的场景重建数据进行路径规划，原因在于操作人员无法在每次任务前对大型或偏远场地进行重新测绘。因此，机器人必须利用假设地形保持不变的陈旧地图做出长期规划决策，即便环境物理变化可能导致先前可行的路径在任务执行时变得不安全或无法通行。我们提出一种物理可行性世界模型，用于评估未来地形变化下机器人导航的假设情景分析。该系统通过将重建的3D高斯泼溅场景与基于物理的仿真相结合，在不重新采集传感器数据或重建地图的前提下，生成同一环境的物理修正版本。随后我们实现一种考虑地形感知的规划器，能够应对世界模型所模拟的物理事件、障碍物与变形。这使得机器人及人类操作员可在确认执行规划路径前评估其可行性，尤其适用于条件变化后撤退或恢复可能失效的受限环境。我们在德克萨斯州中部的真实野外场地，通过多种严重程度模拟洪涝场景对系统进行测试，在物理仿真干预导致地形条件恶化过程中，测量路径与任务可行性。结果表明，物理可行性世界模型能够揭示仅基于原始重建环境规划时难以察觉的长期路径失效与重规划行为，从而使机器人在部署前即可评估未来地形变化对路径可行性的影响。

title: Learning from Demonstration via Spatiotemporal Tubes for Unknown Euler-Lagrange Systems
summary: We present STT-LfD, a unified Learning from Demonstration (LfD) framework that integrates motion learning with control for unknown Euler-Lagrange systems. Unlike traditional decoupled approaches that track a fixed reference, the proposed method treats demonstrations as a data-driven safety specification. Using heteroscedastic Gaussian Processes, STT-LfD learns Spatiotemporal Tubes (STTs) as an intent envelope that capture time-varying precision requirements of a task. A closed-form feedback controller then enforces these learned constraints while respecting actuator limits, without requiring explicit system identification. The approach preserves the temporal structure of demonstrations, remains computationally efficient, and avoids explicit system identification. Hardware experiments on a mobile robot and a 7-DOF manipulator show that it outperforms baselines in robustness to disturbances and computational speed.
tldr: This paper proposes STT-LfD, a Learning from Demonstration framework that uses spatiotemporal tubes learned via heteroscedastic Gaussian Processes to encode task intent and a feedback controller to enforce constraints, demonstrated on a mobile robot and a 7-DOF manipulator for robust and computationally efficient imitation learning.
tldr_zh: 本文提出STT-LfD，一种将演示作为安全性规范的学习框架，通过异方差高斯过程学习时空管以编码任务意图，并利用反馈控制器执行约束，在移动机器人和七自由度机械臂上验证了其鲁棒性和计算效率。
summary_zh: 我们提出STT-LfD，一种统一的示教学习（LfD）框架，它将运动学习与控制相集成，适用于未知的欧拉-拉格朗日系统。与跟踪固定参考的传统解耦方法不同，所提方法将示教视为数据驱动的安全规范。STT-LfD利用异方差高斯过程，学习时空管（STT）作为意图包络，捕捉任务中随时间变化的精度要求。随后，一个闭式反馈控制器在执行器限制下强制执行这些已学习的约束，而无需显式的系统辨识。该方法保留了示教的时间结构，保持计算高效，并避免了显式的系统辨识。在移动机器人和七自由度机械臂上的硬件实验表明，该方法在抗扰动鲁棒性和计算速度方面优于基线方法。

title: Robust Operational Space Control with Conformal Disturbance Bounds for Safe Redundant Manipulation
summary: Redundant robotic manipulators operating in constrained and human-interactive environments require accurate task-space tracking together with rigorous safety guarantees under dynamic uncertainties. Classical operational space computed torque controller (OSCTC) relies on accurate dynamic models and degrades in the presence of disturbances. In contrast, the data-driven paradigm of residual learning approximates disturbances as functions learned from full-state measurements, which are often noisy in practice, lack rigorous theoretical guarantees, and introduce additional design complexity. This paper proposes a robust OSCTC framework that integrates an extended state observer (ESO) with conformal prediction to combine model-based robustness and data-driven adaptability. The ESO estimates lumped disturbances directly in operational space without requiring full-state measurements as in residual learning, and a robust control barrier function (CBF) is constructed to enforce safety under uncertainty. However, robust CBFs require a known disturbance-variation bound to guarantee absolute safety, which often leads to conservatism in practice. To address this limitation, we further employ a sliding-window conformal prediction mechanism to estimate the bound online in a distribution-free manner, thereby achieving practical probabilistic safety guarantees. Experiments on a 7-DoF Franka Research 3 manipulator demonstrate millimeter-level tracking accuracy and real-time safe control at 1~kHz under various disturbances.
tldr: This paper proposes a robust operational space controller that combines an extended state observer with conformal prediction to achieve safe and accurate control of redundant manipulators under dynamic uncertainties, validated on a Franka Research 3 robot.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种结合扩展状态观测器与共形预测的鲁棒操作空间控制器，在动态不确定性下实现冗余机械臂的安全和精确控制，并在Franka Research 3机器人上进行了验证。
summary_zh: 冗余机械臂在受限及人机交互环境中运行时，需在动态不确定性下实现精确的任务空间跟踪并具备严格的安全保障。经典操作空间计算力矩控制器（OSCTC）依赖精确动力学模型，在扰动存在时性能会下降。相比之下，基于残差学习的数据驱动范式将扰动近似为从全状态测量中学习得到的函数，但实际中测量常含噪声、缺乏严格理论保证且会引入额外设计复杂性。本文提出一种鲁棒OSCTC框架，将扩展状态观测器（ESO）与保形预测相结合，融合了基于模型的鲁棒性与数据驱动的适应性。ESO直接在操作空间中估计集总扰动，无需像残差学习那样依赖全状态测量，并构建鲁棒控制障碍函数（CBF）以在不确定性下保障安全。然而，鲁棒CBF需已知扰动变化界以保证绝对安全，这在实际中常导致保守性。为突破这一局限，我们进一步采用滑窗保形预测机制，以无分布方式在线估计该边界，从而实现实用的概率安全保证。在七自由度Franka Research 3机械臂上的实验表明，该方法在多种扰动下可实现毫米级跟踪精度及1kHz频率下的实时安全控制。

title: Distributed Multi Robot Lunar Cargo Transportation via Phase Decomposed Reinforcement Learning
summary: Modular reconfigurable robotic systems provide a scalable solution for cooperative surface operations in future lunar missions. However, cooperative cargo transportation remains challenging due to morphology-dependent topology changes, strong payload-induced coupling, long-horizon decision making, and safety constraints. This paper proposes a phase-decomposed reinforcement learning framework for cooperative cargo transport with distributed robotic units. The task is decomposed into lifting, transportation, and placement, each optimized with a dedicated joint-state policy capturing inter-agent coupling. Centralized training promotes stable convergence, while deployment uses onboard proprioception for control and OptiTrack motion capture for ground-truth evaluation and post-processed metrics. A deterministic phase controller expressed in Markov state representation regulates transitions between stages, and a failure-sensitive synchronization mechanism ensures coordinated progression and safety-aware halting during real-world execution. The framework is evaluated in simulation and through controlled field experiments at a JAXA space exploration test facility. Results demonstrate reliable cooperative transport across all stages in both simulation and hardware experiments.
tldr: A phase-decomposed reinforcement learning framework for cooperative lunar cargo transport using distributed modular robots, validated in simulation and real-world experiments at a JAXA facility.
tldr_zh: 提出一种相位分解强化学习框架，用于分布式模块化机器人的月球货物协同运输，在仿真和JAXA真实实验中验证。
summary_zh: 模块化可重构机器人系统为未来月球任务中的协同表面作业提供了可扩展的解决方案。然而，由于形态依赖的拓扑变化、强有效载荷耦合效应、长时域决策制定以及安全约束等问题，协同货物运输仍具挑战性。本文提出了一种面向分布式机器人单元协同货物运输的相位分解强化学习框架。该任务被分解为起吊、运输与放置三个阶段，每个阶段均采用专用联合状态策略进行优化，以捕获智能体间的耦合关系。集中式训练促进稳定收敛，而部署阶段则利用机载本体感觉进行控制，并采用OptiTrack运动捕捉系统实现真值评估与后处理指标计算。基于马尔可夫状态表示表达的确定性相位控制器调节阶段间转换，同时故障敏感同步机制确保实际执行过程中的协调推进与安全感知暂停。该框架在仿真环境及日本宇宙航空研究开发机构（JAXA）太空探索试验设施的控制场地实验中进行了评估。结果表明，在仿真与硬件实验中，该方法均能实现所有阶段的可靠协同运输。

title: Language-Critique Imitation Learning from Suboptimal Demonstrations
summary: Prior work on imitation learning from suboptimal demonstrations typically relies on compressed supervision signals such as confidence estimates, discriminator scores, or importance weights. These scalar signals are inherently limited, as they cannot explicitly express intermediate reasoning about task progress, failure modes, or corrective actions. We propose a language-critique framework for imitation learning from suboptimal demonstrations that instead leverages natural language as a structured supervision signal, avoiding the collapse of expressive feedback into scalars. Our method first constructs language labels from demonstrations that explicitly describe current progress, identify suboptimal behaviors, and provide fine-grained corrective guidance. We then introduce a language-critique loss that directly trains policies using these structured signals without reducing them to scalars, and instantiate it for both behavior cloning and diffusion policies, yielding LC-BC and LC-DP. We further provide a theoretical result showing that the proposed objective upper-bounds the expert performance gap under standard assumptions. Empirically, we evaluate on diverse continuous control tasks spanning navigation, manipulation, and gameplay, where our methods consistently outperform strong imitation learning and offline reinforcement learning baselines. These results demonstrate that language can serve as a powerful and structured form of supervision for learning robust policies from suboptimal data.
tldr: This paper introduces a language-critique framework that uses natural language as structured supervision signals for imitation learning from suboptimal demonstrations, consistently outperforming baselines on navigation, manipulation, and gameplay tasks.
tldr_zh: 本文提出了一种语言批评框架，利用自然语言作为结构化监督信号从次优演示中进行模仿学习，在导航、操作和游戏任务上持续优于基线方法。
summary_zh:
摘要：  
针对次优示范的模仿学习前期工作通常依赖压缩监督信号，如置信度估计、判别器得分或重要性权重。这些标量信号存在固有局限性，无法明确表达关于任务进展、故障模式或纠正动作的中间推理过程。我们提出一种基于语言评述的次优示范模仿学习框架，该框架利用自然语言作为结构化监督信号，避免将表达性反馈压缩为标量。本方法首先从示范中构建语言标签，清晰描述当前进展、识别次优行为并提供细粒度的纠正指导。随后我们提出语言评述损失函数，直接利用这些结构化信号训练策略而不将其降维为标量，并分别将其实例化为行为克隆与扩散策略，形成LC-BC与LC-DP。我们进一步提供理论结果，证明在标准假设下所提目标函数是专家性能差距的上界。实验方面，我们评估了涵盖导航、操作与游戏博弈的多种连续控制任务，本方法一致优于强模仿学习与离线强化学习基线。这些结果表明，语言可作为强大且结构化的监督形式，从次优数据中学习鲁棒策略。

title: Valdi: Value Diffusion World Models
summary: World models can enable Model Predictive Control (MPC), but this requires dynamics prediction that is both fast enough for online use and expressive enough to represent uncertain futures. Diffusion models offer a natural mechanism for modeling uncertain dynamics, yet their iterative inference procedure makes them difficult to use for low-latency latent planning. We bridge this gap with Value Diffusion World Models (Valdi), combining end-to-end online training for MPC with a latent diffusion dynamics model. In preliminary experiments on the CarRacing environment, we show that Valdi, using a single diffusion step at both training and inference, matches a deterministic MLP baseline. Our experiments expose a trade-off between predictive multimodality and control performance in this setup. Code is available at https://github.com/Kit115/ValueDiffusionWorldModels.
tldr: Valdi combines latent diffusion world models with online MPC, using a single diffusion step for fast planning and showing a trade-off between multimodality and control on CarRacing.
tldr_zh: Valdi将潜在扩散世界模型与在线MPC相结合，通过单步扩散实现快速规划，并在CarRacing中展示了多模态与控制性能的权衡。
summary_zh: 世界模型能够支持模型预测控制（MPC），但这要求动力学预测既能满足在线应用的实时性，又能充分表达不确定的未来状态。扩散模型为建模不确定动力学提供了天然机制，但其迭代推理过程增加了在低延迟潜在规划中的应用难度。我们通过价值扩散世界模型（Valdi）弥合了这一差距，将面向MPC的端到端在线训练与潜在扩散动力学模型相结合。在CarRacing环境的初步实验中，我们证明Valdi在训练和推理时仅需单步扩散即可达到确定性MLP基线的性能水平。实验揭示了该框架下预测多模态性与控制性能之间的权衡关系。代码开源地址：https://github.com/Kit115/ValueDiffusionWorldModels

title: GaussianFusion: Unified 3D Gaussian Representation for Multi-Modal Fusion Perception
